message.content: The sculpture most often cited as the quintessential masterpiece of the 19th‑century is **Auguste Rodin’s “The Thinker”** (created 1880–1902). Originally conceived as part of his monumental work *The Gates of Hell*, the bronze figure of a man in deep contemplation has since become an icon of modern sculpture, reproduced in countless editions and celebrated worldwide for its psychological depth and technical mastery.
